# Gambeta

Gambeta is a free browser game about Argentine football: a draft with real historical squads (1994–today), a 15-season player career from the fourth division up, a daily challenge with the same draw for everyone, and an ELO ranking.

Play: https://gambetafutbol.games/
Draft: https://gambetafutbol.games/draft/
Career: https://gambetafutbol.games/carrera/
Daily challenge: https://gambetafutbol.games/daily/
Spanish discovery: https://gambetafutbol.games/juegos-de-futbol-argentino/
Like Copero / El Ídolo: https://gambetafutbol.games/juegos-como-copero/
English: https://gambetafutbol.games/en/football-draft-game/
Portuguese: https://gambetafutbol.games/pt/monte-seu-time/

No download, no required account, nothing paid inside the game.
